ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low macro-level ratio; approximately 0.04:1 (white/high-intensity to black/low-intensity) pixel count across the visible fluke area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid low-intensity dark-spectrum pixels form the primary background. High-intensity (white) focal spots are distributed as follows: a dense cluster at the left distal tip, a vertical alignment of three spots on the mid-left lobe, and scattered individuals across the right lobe. Heterogeneous tan/white textured blobs are concentrated at both distal terminals.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central notch with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 132 degrees and a shallow vertical penetration depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (2-10 pixel variations) along the entire trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a more distinct jagged topography compared to the left lobe boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetric concave upward sweep from the median notch to the distal tips, terminating in irregular, bulbous geometric structures at the lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct circular high-intensity clusters (3-12 pixel radius) primarily located along the mid-inner lobes and concentrated heavily at both distal tips, suggesting barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive macro-textured barnacle colonization at both the left and right distal tips, significantly altering the expected smooth geometric contour of the fluke lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish-orange pixel clusters mixed with white textured masses at the lobe tips, contrasting with the monochromatic dark surface of the main fluke body.
